item.description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Oprah Winfrey, who's bringing an unusual show called "AHA" to Sphere in Las Vegas next year.

item.title: 'Bad Boy For Life' investigates the culture that enabled Sean Combs' alleged abuse
item.description: Rolling Stone reporter Cheyenne Roundtree says rumors of abuse followed the media mogul for years. Her book examines how Combs remained so powerful, despite decades of warning signs and allegations.

item.title: Mahershala Ali stars as a devout father of three, making ends meet as a hitman
item.description: It's not easy, killing people and raising a family. The new action-thriller Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother reaffirms the power of faith — and delights in outrageous juxtapositions.

item.title: 'Empire' asks: When a child dies, who pays the price?
item.description: Set in the same universe as Tahir's Ember in Ashes series, Empire picks up right where the last book, 'Heir' left off — with S'rsha attached to the very monster she sought to destroy.

item.title: What painter Sliman Mansour told NPR about Palestinian rights and art before he died
item.description: Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour spent his life painting the faces and landscapes of Israeli occupation. His sons say NPR was the last media to meet him before he died in August.

item.title: Girl accuses Braden Peters, social media influencer known as 'Clavicular,' of rape
item.description: The allegations claim Braden Peters, also known as Clavicular, had non-consensual sex with the 17-year-old female victim after plying her with alcohol. Peters' representative denies the charges.
